explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV (proton + eta mass), so this final state is kinematically impossible to produce at this point -- it is not merely a lookup-table gap. Note this is unrelated to the Delta(1232) resonance; eta photoproduction opens about 250 MeV higher than the pion threshold. To proceed, increase W to at least 1.4961 GeV (also required to stay within the eta lookup table's W coverage of [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV).
